prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash (severity of injuries, disputed liability, insurance limits, whether the case may go to trial), your budget and preferences, and the lawyer’s experience with similar cases.

Well-regarded Chicago personal-injury firms (good places to start):
- Clifford Law Offices — large, longtime plaintiff firm that handles catastrophic injury and wrongful-death cases.
- Corboy & Demetrio — established trial firm with a strong record in serious injury and wrongful‑death suits.
- Levin & Perconti — known for auto-accident and catastrophic-injury representation.
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — plaintiff trial attorneys with a history of major verdicts and settlements.
- Power Rogers & Smith — plaintiff-focused firm that handles auto and catastrophic-injury claims.

How to pick the best attorney for your case
- Relevant experience: ask how many car-accident cases they’ve handled like yours and how many went to trial.
- Track record: ask for sample settlements/verdicts for comparable cases.
- Resources: make sure the firm can retain medical experts, accident reconstructionists, etc.
- Communication style: how often and how will they update you; who will handle day-to-day contact.
- Fees: most work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Get the fee percentage and any costs you might owe.
- Local knowledge: experience with the courts and judges in the county where your case would be filed.
- Client reviews and peer ratings: check Avvo, Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Google reviews.

Questions to ask at a free consult
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? Outcome?
- Do you take these cases on contingency? What percentage and who pays expenses?
- Will you or another attorney handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your approach to settlement vs. trial?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

If you want, tell me:
- the neighborhood or ZIP code in Chicago,
- brief details of the crash and injuries,
- any special needs (language, mobility, preference for small or large firm),

and I can pull together a short list of attorneys near you with contact details and recent ratings.
